Qwen35CheckpointRetentionLiveTests.swift (head lines ~131-136): the expected retained SSD cache positions for the donor test change from the fixed [2048, 4096, 6144] to [2048, 4096, latest]. `latest` is computed from the prompt length minus a 64-token margin, aligned to the block size, with a precondition that it exceeds 6144 by at least 1024 tokens. This implies a production change in CBv2SchedulerConfig.demandedLatestPromptEndMarginTokens, where the deepest cached boundary becomes an end-of-prompt cut instead of the last full chunk end. That production source is not in this batch. T-041 covers cached prefixes, HMAC-keyed names, the 30-minute TTL, and cacheSalt scoping. If the production change makes donations or boundaries more granular, the at-rest exposure stays the same in kind, since the same encrypted DBK3 files, HMAC tags, and per-donation 1,024-token benefit floor apply. The test asserts `filesWritten == 3` and retains the 1,024-token floor, which is consistent with that. I could not verify this. The next review pass should check the production scheduler and SSD donation changes (SSDPrefixCache.donate, the benefit-floor gate, the cacheSalt fold) if they are in the PR.
